events.verdict: Dort (OKC) establishes himself in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Gobert (MIN) is in the paint for three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Dort (OKC) is bracing for the contact from Towns (MIN) and marginal contact occurs as he releases away from the contact.
Towns (MIN) moves forward into Dort (OKC) and initiates contact that affects his shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) is already in Dort's (OKC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Holmgren (OKC) and Gobert (MIN) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Joe (OKC) reaches across Gobert's (MIN) arm and initiates contact that affects Gobert's SQBR.
Gobert (MIN) legally contests Holmgren's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) raises his arm to pursue the rebound, and incidental contact occurs with Gobert's (MIN) arm prior to Dort dislodging the ball.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Dort's (OKC) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) legally contests Conley's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) and McDaniels (MIN) come together at the same spot and incidental foot to foot contact occurs in the backcourt.
Towns (MIN) is late to the spot and does not establish a legal guarding position in Williams' (OKC) path prior to contact.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) was confirmed. 
 Holmgren (OKC) makes contact with the ball after it has touched the backboard.
Conley (MIN) commits a take foul on Joe (OKC).
Gobert (MIN) turns into Williams (OKC) with his arms extended forward and delivers contact during the pick.
Dort (OKC) initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) lower body that affects his jump shot attempt.
Edwards' (MIN) free throw does not make contact with the rim.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Thunder.
Edwards (MIN) commits a take foul on Williams (OKC).
